claims.claim: ScreenPolish automatically zooms in on clusters of clicks in a recording.
ScreenPolish redraws the cursor smoothly and adds a ripple effect on clicks.
ScreenPolish places the recording inside a padded frame on a gradient background.
ScreenPolish can show the user's webcam as a bubble over the recording.
ScreenPolish exports MP4 or GIF files in landscape, square, or vertical formats.
ScreenPolish runs on Windows and Linux, and has an early macOS build.
ScreenPolish works fully locally and recordings never leave the user's machine.
On Linux under Wayland, ScreenPolish reconstructs the pointer path from Hyprland's IPC socket.
On Linux, ScreenPolish reads mouse clicks from evdev input devices.
ScreenPolish deliberately never opens keyboard input devices.
On Linux, ScreenPolish captures the screen through xdg-desktop-portal and PipeWire.
In ScreenPolish, preview and export use the same renderer, with each effect computed from the frame, the recorded events, and the settings.
Bot Forge is a plugin for Nous Research's Hermes Agent.
A user can describe a bot in one sentence and Bot Forge creates the complete bot.
Each new bot gets a generated name and avatar.
Each new bot gets a purpose-written SOUL.md file and seeded memory.
Bot Forge gives new bots tools and skills, and can add scheduled cron routines.
On Linux and macOS, Bot Forge sets up a gateway service for the new bot that starts on login.
Bot Forge verifies each step as it runs and rolls back the whole bot if any step fails.
Bot Forge can be installed with a single command.
Agent Dock lets the user chat directly with any configured specialist profile, even while the main orchestrator is busy.
Agent Dock can float as a card or dock into the workspace, and it remembers the chosen mode.
In Agent Dock, a message becomes tracked Kanban work only when the user explicitly assigns it as a task.
Agent Dock discovers the profiles that Hermes already knows about instead of creating new ones.
Agent Dock's installer uses only the Python standard library.
Agent Dock ships with a security policy and documented release testing.
Mission Control is a workspace for planning, drafting, and publishing content for an X account.
In Mission Control, agent profiles move work through research, draft, and verify steps.
Nothing is published from Mission Control without review by the account owner.
Mission Control uses a Supabase backend with a local SQLite fallback.
Mission Control's Supabase database uses row-level security.
Mission Control only accepts video research links from an allowlist of hosts.
